## 2026-11-10 (VSP gun-check fees — November partial payment fixed; agent now self-retries daily)

- **What happened:** the 11/5 10:15 run paid ROA $112 (#105069078), then crashed opening Customer Search for WAY (`waiting for locator("#Icxgocontrol")` — the portal tab went stale during the checkout; NOT a portal UI change: the same locator worked for all 5 stores in that run's read pass and in today's runs). The crash ended the run, and the agent only fired on the 5th, so WAY $64 / HAR $72 / CUL $179 / LEX $88 ($403, all due 12/01) would have sat until 12/5 — after the due date (10% penalty).
- **Fix in `bin/vsp_fee_pay.py`** (backup `fleet/_backups/vsp_fee_pay.py.bak-pre-retryfix-20261110`): (1) `goto_search` waits for the Go button to be visible, reloads up to 3x, and signs back in once if the session expired (screenshot `search-stuck-*.png` if it still fails); (2) every store's payment runs in a fresh tab and inside its own try/except — one store's failure never stops the rest; (3) Payment Type select is waited for, set, verified and re-set before each Next (WAY stuck on "Payment Type is missing" in today's first test); (4) month file keeps `paid_this_month` confirmations across runs and a store already paid (file or portal) is skipped quietly; (5) login guard now also holds across days until the Keychain password changes (fingerprint), so daily runs can never stack failed logins toward the 5-try lockout; (6) DMs only on payments made, or once from the 25th if anything is still unpaid — no daily failure pings.
- **Schedule:** `fleet/com.valleypawn.vsp-fee-pay.plist` now fires daily 10:15 on the 5th–28th (backup `.bak-pre-daily-20261110`); reinstalled via `install_agent.sh` (bootstrapped, exit 0). A fully paid month exits after the balance read with no DM.
- **Verified:** two `--pay --dry-run --no-dm` runs via the host queue. Second run (12:54–12:58 ET): ROA balance $0.00 (paid), WAY/HAR/CUL/LEX each reached the NIC review screen with the right FIRE invoice and amount, e-check ****2797, Full Circle Finance Inc. Review PNGs in `Compliance/vsp/2026-11/`.
